review.provenance: Every visible line of v1 /careers/ <main>: Careers at / High Society (the h1, joined: structure map), Join the High Society Team (the hero line), Employment Application + the four-line invitation (joined into one paragraph, words unchanged), Personal Information, every field label and placeholder, Employment Type (Full-time, Part-time; v1's default Full-time), Upload Resume + its line, Previous Work Experience (Start Date, End Date, Name of Company), Role (Budtender, Receptionist, Inventory Specialist; v1's default Inventory Specialist), Preferred Location (the 8 stores from site.json; v1's default New Buffalo), Submit Application. v1 lines 0 and 4 'Please add a content...' are empty CMS slots (structure map note): not rendered. The '?' after the select values (v1 lines 19, 30, 35) is a broken arrow-icon glyph, not a word: the native selects draw their own arrow.
review.typo: High Society's resume line says 'Browse and chose the files ...' (choose). Kept verbatim (High Society's own words; not a declared defect in docs/hs-source-defects.json); listed in docs/requests/pages.md for the client.
review.form: v1's custom dropdowns (spans + hidden inputs employment_type, role, location) are native <select>s with the same names and values; the address inputs keep v1's names and placeholders and get labels read by screen readers (their placeholder words). Posts where v1 posts (https://highsocietydispo.com/do_actions/do_form_submit, form_id 4). NOT VERIFIED that the CMS accepts a post from a page it did not serve (no _nonce); not tested on purpose (a test application would reach High Society). Listed in docs/requests/pages.md.
review.image: hero-pit-wall (v2's race-day photo) as the hero, decorative.
